derivation: from the pagan deity (i.e. the sun;
def: from G622 (ἀπόλλυμι)); Apollonia, a place in Macedonia

occurrences.text: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:
